Taimanin. A graduate of Gosha Academy who fights at the front lines. A woman with an elegant and soft aura. A colleague and friend of the Storm Fan, Mitsuki Hoshino, with whom she has completed numerous missions. She's often treated like a child due to her small physique, and she seems to be bothered by it.

User of Light Art. She wields a spear made of a special alloy as a weapon. If the weapon isn't used as a catalyst, she can't use the ninja art properly. Her skill, "Rending Radiance", loads up her weapon and shoots light particles stored in its magazine. By adjusting her weapon, she can choose to fire either an ultra-thick or a dispersed laser.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_120
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. A Wind Art user who can manipulate the air using a specially designed umbrella. She uses a ninja art, 'Wind God's Rage', which allows her to create whirlwinds freely. She's also good at protecting allies by using the special alloy umbrella or making storm barriers.

She hails from a renowned ninja clan and grew up like a princess, so she is shy around strangers.

She's used to being alone, but feels lonely at the same time. She hopes to get along with many friends in real life, but she has pretty much given up on the idea because of the fear of getting rejected.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_121
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. She uses Stone Art to cover her body with stones or to capture enemies.

It is said that some people among her predecessors were able to make a giant doll made of rock, a golem. Although she has yet to achieve the level of her predecessors, she works hard every day to be a great Stone Art user like them.

Akina is a ramen maniac. She always goes to a ramen store after a hard mission or training session to release stress by eating ramen.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_122
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a third-year student at Gosha Academy. An elite Taimanin as well as a Puppet Art user. Her puppet, however, is controlled remotely by her Particles, not strings.

Her puppet is embedded with a medium that sends Particles to each body part, allowing it to move like a human being and rip enemies apart with its sharp claws. She can only control a puppet for an hour at most.

When the word Puppet Art user comes to mind, it's easy to think that the puppet masters let the puppet do the fighting while they hide in the shadows, but she uses her puppet as a diversion so that she can slay her enemies with her sword.

Ever since the death of her parents, she has been the head of her family, raising two younger sisters and a younger brother. But when she's away from home and on her missions, the old lady of Inageya takes care of her siblings instead.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_123
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin. She devotes herself wholeheartedly—both in body and spirit—to pursuing Murakumo Gennosuke, the Taimanin swordsman who was exiled from the school of Itto Style. Harboring feelings for him, she follows him wherever he goes, no matter the destination.

She is a practitioner of the restorative ninja art known as "Rejuvenation Art". However, even with this technique, she could not heal Gennosuke’s already ruined body; at best, she could only suppress his symptoms. Though she has learned the teachings of Itto Style directly from Gennosuke, her swordsmanship remains average for a Taimanin.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_124
DisplayDesc:
Demon, a Nomad warrior. A fallen noble who seeks a position among the leadership to restore her family's lost glory. Proud and ambitious, she views everyone around her as a rival standing in the way of her rise. By making effective use of her abilities, she has completed missions and secured a measure of control, yet she seems to harbor a deep‑seated complex about the means by which she achieved it.

In her normal state, her strength is unremarkable, little different from that of an ordinary combatant. However, she possesses a unique power that draws strength from emotions such as rage, hatred, and pain—meaning she can only fight at full capacity after suffering humiliation, such as being defeated and captured. Because of this, she often avoids direct combat, instead deliberately allowing herself to be captured to infiltrate enemy territory. Once inside, she conducts espionage—gathering or manipulating information—before single‑handedly devastating the enemy from within.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_125
DisplayDesc:
Demon. A high-ranking oni warrior from Nyogonoshima and the boss of "Kibushu", one of the most prominent crime syndicates in Tokyo Kingdom. She stands in sharp opposition to Nomad, with whom she vies for power in Tokyo Kingdom, yet she is a drinking buddy with Francis, the head of the Francis Family.

A master of lightning‑fast swordsmanship, her speed is said to rival that of Igawa Asagi, the Almighty Taimanin. She also possesses a powerful regenerative ability, earning her the nickname "Ravana the Immortal" in Nyogonoshima, where she is regarded with fear.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_126
DisplayDesc:
Demon. An executive of "Kibushu", one of the major crime syndicates in the Tokyo Kingdom. Takes on the appearance of a warrior, distinguished by a long single horn protruding from the center of its forehead. An assassination maniac who boasts, "I have no interest in money. My trade is reaping lives."

It has mastered stealth techniques such as infiltration and substitution, and its strategic sense is formidable. Its close-quarters combat skills even surpass those of Francis, the head of the Francis Family, making it a true powerhouse. It emerges as if seeping out from space, cutting down its targets with a laser blade.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_127
DisplayDesc:
Demon. An executive of "Kibushu", one of the major crime syndicates in the Tokyo Kingdom. Has a strict personality and a competitive spirit, always looking forward to matches against powerful individuals. At the same time, he shows a diligent side, often taking care of his fellow teammates or executives.

As a sorcerer, he specializes in wind magic. Repels enemy attacks with violent storms and can even blow away his opponents, tearing them to shreds. Not only can he summon raging storms, but he can also stir up light breezes, freely demonstrating delicate and precise control of the wind.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_128
DisplayDesc:
Demon. An executive of "Kibushu" or "Oni Warrior Horde", one of the five major crime syndicates in Tokyo Kingdom. Slightly enjoys napping more than the snacks she eats three times a day, and is asleep during the day for much longer than she is awake. Made a water yokai "Mizuchi" into her familiar, and often uses it as her pillow while she dozes off.

Although she has the ability to bend water at will, she is less powerful when she is awake. When asleep, Mizuchi automatically attacks enemies, and with the "Suiseiken," a flowing water blade that grows stronger the more she sleeps, she cuts down her foes.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_129
DisplayDesc:
Beastman. Settled in a corner of Yomihara at some point and seems to have become something of a mascot among the locals. Free-spirited and straightforward, she basically only thinks about eating, playing, and sleeping. Like a cat, she wanders her territory aimlessly, looking for food along the way.

Not affiliated with any organization, she has fought against both Taimanins and UFS personnel. However, her nature leads her to treat battles as playtime and her enemies as playmates. True to her feline nature, she is swift, outmaneuvering her foes with physical abilities far beyond those of an ordinary human.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_130
DisplayDesc: Demon. Although an inhabitant of the Demon Realm, it can be found in the human world in places where demonic organizations lie, such as Tokyo Kingdom or Yomihara. With its distinct physical features like a developed chin and canines, it has superhuman strength but is just a mere civilian who is a coward. But to those weaker than itself, it becomes ruthless and uses crude weapons, like a metal pipe, to weakly resist against a greater power.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_131
DisplayDesc: Demon. Although an inhabitant of the Demon Realm, it can be found in the human world in places where demonic organizations lie, such as Tokyo Kingdom or Yomihara. It is considered weak among demons, so rather than moving alone, it joins organizations and uses its superhuman strength in the human world to become a thug and threaten others.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_132
DisplayDesc: Demon. Although an inhabitant of the Demon Realm, it can be found in the human world in places where demonic organizations lie, such as Tokyo Kingdom or Yomihara. Using its superhuman strength, it does work that requires physical power, especially one that involves violence. Some of these kinds use weapons like claws skillfully, building a reputation in the underworld.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_133
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, these kinds have completely settled in the human world, doing tough work for a living. The executor is a tough job doing all kinds of work, but for an orc who came from rock bottom, it is considered a profession to settle down. From finding people to collecting debts, it does anything it is told, like waiting in line for a popular store to open.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_134
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, these kinds have completely settled in the human world, doing tough work for a living. Orcs who have gained experience in crime syndicates of the human world mostly claim their place as the assault commander. With a crude fireaxe and shield to depend on for their lives, an orc leading their men into battle is feared among civilians who live in the underworld.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_135
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, these have learned the skills to use magic. It uses spells that subdue pain, allowing others to continue with the battle. Even though it knows how to use magic, an orc is an orc, and it favors smacking the enemy with its staff rather than using an attack spell.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_136
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, these have learned the skills to use magic. It's still quite crude, but it uses spells that can heal wounds and stop bleeding. For those in the underworld who believe in superstitions and rely on spells rather than modern medicine, even an orc can be a lifesaver.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_137
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, it possesses superior battle skills and takes on bodyguard missions. It has made its body slim, which is rare for an orc, and shows off both the style that comes from wearing a business suit and the barbarity of swinging an oni club.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_138
DisplayDesc: Among the orcs of the Demon Realm, one can be successful enough to take the place of a crime syndicate warlord. Because it has to focus on business operations, it doesn't usually dirty its own hands. But sometimes, it takes matters directly to show off its "method" that made it a warlord.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_139
DisplayDesc: Demon, an oni. It can usually be seen in places with a strong demonic presence. Its significant physical features are its size, much larger than a human, and its two pairs of arms. Holding a giant axe in one hand, which a human would need two hands to carry, it cuts every enemy in half.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_140
DisplayDesc: Demon, an oni. It can usually be seen in places with a strong demonic presence. Honing its strong physical ability to the extreme, it punches with its two pairs of arms like a sledgehammer, crushing everything in its path.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_141
DisplayDesc: Demon, an oni. It can usually be seen in places with a strong demonic presence. Its demonic energy gathers in its core in the middle of its body, boiling, and it releases this energy to attack. Because of the unstable nature of the energy, it's hard for it to control. So it has to use supplementary tools like wands that don't match its size.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_142
DisplayDesc: Demon, an oni. Adjusting to the culture and life of the human world, it serves as a mercenary in the underworld. Wearing clothes and acting like a Sengoku-era samurai in Japan, it swings the longsword swiftly, performing a precise attack.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_143
DisplayDesc: Demon, an oni. Adjusting to the culture and life in the human world, it serves as a mercenary in the underworld. Wearing clothes and acting like a Sengoku-era samurai in Japan, it uses its bow with superhuman focus, sniping and assassinating a target from long range.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_144
DisplayDesc: A wizard who made a contract with an interdimensional being, allowing it to use supernatural powers. Even though it is borrowing those powers from the said being, it can manipulate the power professionally based on its own understanding and knowledge of it, and can not only attack but also dispel the enemy's magic as well.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_145
DisplayDesc: A wizard who made a contract with an interdimensional being, allowing it to use supernatural powers. It uses all means necessary to fulfill its lust for knowledge, and cases of it destroying an entire village just to test a new destruction spell are common.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_146
DisplayDesc: A demonic beast that dwells in the Demon Realm. It disguises itself as a stone statue, ambushing those who come near. It hardens its skin like rock, blocking attacks, which makes it hard to take down.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_147
DisplayDesc: A demonic beast that dwells in the Demon Realm. It disguises itself as a stone statue, ambushing those who come near. Having a crude demonic energy core in its body, it breathes fire to burn its prey.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_148
DisplayDesc: A demonic beast that dwells in the Demon Realm. It disguises itself as a stone statue, ambushing those who come near. It shoots at its prey, making distance, and reflects attacks when close. A cunning predator.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_149
DisplayDesc: A dog demonized from the miasma of the Demon Realm. It's the size of a cow and has a vicious nature, attacking enemies with its fiery breath. Sometimes, a demon like an orc would keep it as a hound.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_150
DisplayDesc: A dog demonized from the miasma of the Demon Realm. It's the size of a cow and has a vicious nature, shaking enemies to their core by releasing a shockwave through its bark. On rare occasions, a demon would sometimes keep it as a guard dog.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_151
DisplayDesc: Demon. An inhabitant of the Demon Realm with a human body and a horse's head. It has a strong body and power, showing superior battle skills coming from its bare body. There are many cases where these kinds are hired as mercenaries by a high-ranking demon.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_152
DisplayDesc: Demon. An inhabitant of the Demon Realm with a human body and a horse's head. It has a strong body and power, and is skilled at using weapons in combat. These kinds of beings sign up for a demonic military organization, wielding spears at the frontline to make way for their allies.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_153
DisplayDesc: A half-human, half-bird "harpy" that dwells in the Demon Realm. She has the power to control the mind, making her prey go to sleep or break their minds with her cries. She always has a blank face, making it hard to figure out what she's thinking.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_154
DisplayDesc:
Former Taimanin. After graduating from Gosha Academy, she went on several missions, but ditched her own teammates during one to join Nomad. But due to her past occupation as a Taimanin, she's being watched by Nomad's superior executives, Oboro and Ingrid. And someone is always spying on her during missions. The name "Iska" is fake, and her real name is hidden.

As a Taimanin, she can manipulate paper, controlling a mass of it to change or reinforce herself. After joining Nomad, she also underwent a reinforcement surgery, gaining the ability to consume the opponent upon touching them, acquiring their knowledge and information. However, if she uses both of those abilities at the same time, her body shows an adverse reaction.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_155
DisplayDesc: A grim fate for humans who have fallen into an evil demonic cult among those who have immigrated to the Demon Realm. They try to prove the Demon Realm's logic, the law of the jungle, which they are obsessed with using dual blades.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_156
DisplayDesc: A grim fate for humans who have fallen into an evil demonic cult among those who have immigrated to the Demon Realm. By the looks of them wielding a giant blade, they seem to have lost all rationality.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_157
DisplayDesc: A grim fate for humans who have fallen into an evil demonic cult among those who have immigrated to the Demon Realm. As the cult's lapdogs holding a spear, they control other cultists or stand in the front lines of an unholy war.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_158
DisplayDesc: Among the humans who have immigrated to the Demon Realm, they have taken the place of an officer in an evil demonic cult. They act as an "executioner" who tracks down and executes heretics who defy the cult or try to run away from it. They are ruthless with their crossbow, hunting down their prey.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_159
DisplayDesc: Among the humans who have immigrated to the Demon Realm, they have taken the place of the officers in an evil demonic cult. Learning magic that stimulates the mind, they provoke cultists to create a fanatical atmosphere and provide special effects during a speech within the cult.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_160
DisplayDesc: Among the humans who have immigrated to the Demon Realm, they have joined the armed forces of an evil demonic cult. Slashing the enemy with a greatsword, they literally look like "berserkers", but they have the minimum amount of reason and cooperative thoughts to attack together with the other cultists.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_161
DisplayDesc: Among the humans who have immigrated to the Demon Realm, they have joined the armed forces of an evil demonic cult. Wearing armor and holding a mace, they resemble medieval knights, but there's no nobility or honor in their violent actions.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_162
DisplayDesc: Showing promising skills in an evil demonic cult, it ascended to a higher ranking position. Proving its fanatical loyalty and faith toward the cult, it obtained enough power to go against the demons of the Demon Realm by reinforcing and transforming its body with spells. It personally carries out the will of the cult, and punish those non-believers and heretics if needed.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_163
DisplayDesc: A lesser demon that dwells in the Demon Realm. It can be made as a servant at the cost of demonic energy and use its developed eyes for overwatch or recon. It can also shoot the enemies of their master or target by focusing demonic energy in its eye.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_164
DisplayDesc: A lesser demon that dwells in the Demon Realm. It can be made as a servant at the cost of demonic energy and act as an assistant in battle. It has the Evil Eye, which can suppress the enemy's potential and seal their energy, weakening them to make advantages for its master.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_165
DisplayDesc: A lesser demon that dwells in the Demon Realm. It can be made as a servant at the cost of demonic energy and be raised as a pet or a secret weapon. It has a meek hypnotic ability, alluring the opponent as its master commands it to make them allies or confuse the enemy's senses to bring chaos.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_166
DisplayDesc: Demon, an incubus. He usually serves high-ranking demon nobles. By utilizing the incubus's power, which interferes with the minds of intelligent races, he soothes the pain of allies or provokes the enemies' emotions to create a diversion.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_167
DisplayDesc: Demon, an incubus. He usually serves high-ranking demon nobles. By utilizing the incubus's power, which interferes with the minds of intelligent races, he binds the enemies' minds, halting their movements and suppressing them.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_168
DisplayDesc: Demon, a succubus. She usually serves high-ranking demon nobles. By hypnotizing intelligent races to go to sleep, she uses dreams as a conduit to drain their life energy or destroy the mind itself to assassinate the target.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_169
DisplayDesc: Demon, a succubus. She usually serves high-ranking demon nobles. Her abilities as a succubus are lacking, but she changes her own passion and strong emotions into literal fire, setting enemies ablaze.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_170
DisplayDesc: A giant worm-like demon beast that lives underground in the Demon Realm. It sometimes comes over to the human world, disturbing the ecosystem. It spits poison to paralyze its prey, and then sucks its bodily fluids to eat them.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_171
DisplayDesc: A giant worm-like demon beast that lives underground in the Demon Realm. It sometimes comes over to the human world, disturbing the ecosystem. It has a habit of spitting acidic poison to weaken its prey when hunting. The said poison is sometimes used as a natural cutting fluid in the Demon Realm.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_172
DisplayDesc: A giant worm-like demon beast that lives underground in the Demon Realm. It sometimes comes over to the human world, disturbing the ecosystem. Mostly found in the volcanic regions, this subspecies has lost its poison but gained the ability to spit overheated bodily fluids.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_173
DisplayDesc: A monstrosity that looks like a fish. It appears both in the human world and the Demon Realm, disturbing the ecosystem. But its life or origins are still mysterious. Those who have adjusted to the cold waters of the Demon Realm's ocean shoot deep-freeze water to freeze their prey.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_174
DisplayDesc: A monstrosity that looks like a fish. It appears both in the human world and the Demon Realm, disturbing the ecosystem. But its life or origins are still mysterious. Those who have adjusted to the deep seas of the human world are especially fast and fierce, swinging their fins like a blade when hunting.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_175
DisplayDesc: A monstrosity that looks like the combination of a squid and a jellyfish. This mysterious creature appeared one day in both the human world and the Demon Realm. Rumors say that it's an experimental subject that broke out of a research facility, but the truth remains unknown. For now, it's still considered a monster with origins unknown. It swims through the air like water and swings its tentacles to bind its prey, eating them.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_176
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin. While fighting on the field, she is also an instructor at Gosha Academy. She is strict not only with others but also with herself, and is always confident and fair, earning respect from students. However, she uses her X-ray powers to look through student pranks and scolds them strictly, so some students are afraid of her.

Her ninja art can see through objects, which helps her locate hidden enemies or their positions to strike them down with her whip. Her aggressive battle methods are not only well known throughout Taimanins but also in other organizations as well.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_177
DisplayDesc:
A cyborg military dog from a combat drone series, developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It operates in auto-combat mode, attacking any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_178
DisplayDesc:
A cyborg military dog from a combat drone series, developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It operates in auto-combat mode, attacking any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

The Type-R model is an advanced variant equipped with a rocket launcher, greatly enhancing its destructive capability.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_179
DisplayDesc:
A cyborg military dog from a combat drone series, developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It operates in auto-combat mode, attacking any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

The Type-L is a close-combat model equipped with sharp melee weapons and reinforced jaws, maximizing its lethality at close range.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_180
DisplayDesc:
A mass-produced model specialized for close-quarters combat, developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology and UFS's cutting-edge science.

Thanks to its high versatility, it serves as UFS's primary cyborg drone, deployed for urban suppression and control point defense.

The high-voltage stun gun mounted around its mouth can instantly neutralize not only humans but also low-rank demons, and can even eliminate them by releasing a stronger electrical discharge depending on the situation.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_181
DisplayDesc:
A mass-produced, self-destruct model developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology and UFS's cutting-edge science.

Highly cost-efficient, it is deployed as a disposable cyborg drone for large-scale enemy annihilation and key point interception.

It forcibly overloads its internal power core to trigger a high-yield explosion, eliminating both itself and its target.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_182
DisplayDesc:
A modified-human cyborg weapon developed through the inhumane processes of State Task Force "G", using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology and UFS's cutting-edge science.

Built using a living human as its base, most of its body has been replaced with high-performance mechanical components. It operates with the aim of executing missions beyond human limits, leveraging a cyborg's immunity to pain and steel-like durability.

Typically dressed in a suit with black sunglasses, it is specialized for infiltrating agent-protected or heavily guarded urban areas or official events to eliminate targets.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_183
DisplayDesc:
A modified-human cyborg weapon developed through the inhumane processes of State Task Force "G", using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology and UFS's cutting-edge science.

Built using a living human as its base, most of its body has been replaced with high-performance mechanical components. It operates with the aim of executing missions beyond human limits, leveraging a cyborg's immunity to pain and steel-like durability.

Typically dressed in a suit with black sunglasses, it is specialized for infiltrating agent-protected or heavily guarded urban areas or official events to eliminate targets.

Its primary weapon, a specialized briefcase, can instantly transform into heavy armament depending on the situation, unleashing overwhelming firepower.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_184
DisplayDesc:
An experimental robot originally developed by UFS  to replicate the flexible range of motion of the human body while achieving extreme mobility performance.

As demons attacked and created a severe shortage of combat forces across its territories, the unit was urgently recovered and modernized as it was previously abandoned in storage.

Its outdated systems were overhauled with the latest tactical algorithms, and its previously vulnerable armor was replaced with high-strength special alloys, significantly improving combat survivability.

While absolutely obedient to its operator, it is also capable of independent judgment and action in response to rapidly changing combat situations through its high-performance computing system.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_185
DisplayDesc:
A next-generation high-mobility powered exoskeleton suit developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology and UFS's cutting-edge science.

Stable power is ensured through high-density demonic-power battery packs distributed throughout the suit, while jet thrusters mounted on the back and legs enable high-speed flight and aerial maneuverability.

Its primary weapon, Gatling Gun, utilizes precise calculations from an auxiliary processing system to achieve ultra-high-speed targeting and firing beyond human capability.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_186
DisplayDesc:
A bipedal combat drone developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It automatically patrols designated zones and acts as a ruthless killing machine, immediately eliminating any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_187
DisplayDesc:
An artillery-type combat drone developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It automatically guards designated zones and acts as a ruthless killing machine, annihilating any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system that approaches with indiscriminate, long-range bombardment.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_188
DisplayDesc:
A hovering combat drone developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It remains airborne over designated zones to monitor vast areas. Upon locking onto any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system, this killing machine ruthlessly eliminates them under a relentless barrage of quad-linked missiles.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_189
DisplayDesc:
An agent belonging to the UFS's Personal Powered Exoskeleton Unit.

Precision hydraulic actuators translate the user's neural signals into instantaneous mobility, achieving maneuverability that vastly surpasses the limits of human capability.

Armed with an anti-demon CDTE firearms system as their primary weapon, the suit's integrated recoil mitigation system allows for flawless, precision shooting even during high-speed maneuvers.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_190
DisplayDesc:
An agent belonging to the UFS's Personal Powered Exoskeleton Unit.

Precision hydraulic actuators translate the user's neural signals into instantaneous mobility, achieving maneuverability that vastly surpasses the limits of human capability.

Armed with a "High-Frequency Vibration Sword" engineered for maximum cutting power, this agent channels the suit's explosive acceleration into the blade, wielding enough raw cutting force to cleave even the thickest composite armor in two with a single slash.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_191
DisplayDesc:
A special agent belonging to the UFS's Personal Powered Exoskeleton Unit.

With precision hydraulic actuators specialized in shock absorption, the suit delivers an ironclad defense that remains unyielding against any level of firepower.

Characterized by a merciless assault capability that breaches deep into enemy lines while nullifying incoming bombardment, this agent absorbs fierce enemy offensives head-on, shatters their formations, and neutralizes targets with an overwhelming durability that refuses to buckle under any strike.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_192
DisplayDesc:
A special agent belonging to the UFS's Personal Powered Exoskeleton Unit.

With precision hydraulic actuators specialized in shock absorption, the suit delivers an ironclad defense that remains unyielding against any level of firepower.

Characterized by a merciless assault capability that breaches deep into enemy lines while nullifying incoming bombardment, this agent absorbs fierce enemy offensives head-on, shatters their formations, and neutralizes targets with an overwhelming durability that refuses to buckle under any strike.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_193
DisplayDesc:
An experimental combat mecha originally developed by the UFS to counter demons and Taimanins.

As the demon invasion severely depleted military strength across their entire territory, this experimental unit—once left abandoned in a warehouse—was urgently reclaimed and underwent a comprehensive modernization upgrade.

Its outdated systems were completely replaced with the latest tactical algorithms, and the new installation of high-output focused beam cannons on both hands, alongside shoulder-mounted multi-launch missile pods, allows it to achieve overwhelming area-of-effect firepower.

While remaining absolutely obedient to the user's commands, its embedded high-performance processing unit allows the mecha to make independent, autonomous decisions and adapt to the ever-changing conditions of the battlefield.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_194
DisplayDesc:
Demon. Through a bizarre turn of events, the succubus 'Phantasma' fused with a lesser demon named Anna, leading to two distinct personalities coexisting within a single body.

The sensible Anna and the moody Phantasma communicate through "mental conferences" inside their head and maintain a friendly relationship. When necessary, they seamlessly hand over control of the body to divide tasks between them.

On normal days, Anna runs a fortune-telling shop in a quiet corner of Yomihara, where she often helps people locate lost items. Her calm demeanor and soft-spoken nature make her warm and welcoming toward customers, earning her a loyal client base. To express a sense of dignity and mystic charm to her occupation as a fortune teller, she borrows the name of Phantasma.

Phantasma, on the other hand, is a powerful succubus specializing in an art that forces targets into vivid daydreams. Within these daydreams, she can overload her target's mind to incapacitate them, or inflict severe, lethal damage on both body and mind using crafted nightmares and illusions.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_195
DisplayDesc:
A wild dog that has transformed into a demonic beast corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

It ruthlessly attacks any intruder on sight, driven by its extremely ferocious nature and a fierce territorial instinct.

Yet on occasion, those dwelling in the shadows break these beasts, turning them into fiercely loyal guard dogs.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_196
DisplayDesc:
A wild dog that has transformed into a demonic beast corrupted by the dense miasma of the Demon Realm.

It ruthlessly attacks any intruder on sight, driven by its extremely ferocious nature and a fierce territorial instinct.

Notably, its saliva and blood contain a highly concentrated, lethal toxin that even a minor scratch can paralyze a target's senses and gradually corrode their flesh.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_197
DisplayDesc:
A beast that the dense miasma of the Demon Realm has grotesquely contorted.

It ruthlessly attacks any intruder on sight, driven by its extremely ferocious nature with a fierce territorial instinct.

The hideous bones bursting through its flesh have reshaped into razor-sharp blades, ruthlessly piercing and tearing apart any enemy within its reach.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_198
DisplayDesc:
A human that has transformed into a grotesque zombie corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

It is characterized by a form far more twisted than average specimens due to an unexpected mutation.

In particular, the spike-like blades protruding from its abnormally swollen, bizarre arm relentlessly carve through the flesh of the living, while it spits corrosive fluid that dissolves victims without a trace.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_199
DisplayDesc:
A human that has transformed into a grotesque zombie corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

It is characterized by a form far more twisted than average specimens due to an unexpected mutation.

In particular, the bizarre arms sprouting from its shoulders and the razor-sharp claws at the tip mercilessly rip the flesh of the living to shreds.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_200
DisplayDesc:
The remains of a being who once possessed the Particles. Though the dead had entered eternal rest, the miasma of the Demon Realm had forcibly reanimated the deceased. 

While the flesh has weathered away over the ages, only bones remain. The residual Particles within the skeleton react with the demonic energy, causing bizarre phenomena. 

It uproots the tombstone from its own grave, wielding it as a catalyst to channel its demonic power.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_201
DisplayDesc:
The remains of a being who once possessed the Particles. Though the dead had entered eternal rest, the miasma of the Demon Realm had forcibly reanimated the deceased. 

While the flesh has weathered away over the ages, only bones remain. The residual Particles within the skeleton react with the demonic energy, causing bizarre phenomena. 

It possesses great demon power derived from death itself.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_202
DisplayDesc:
A Death Knight that has awakened from the eternal slumber after being corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Set apart from lesser mutants driven solely by instinct, this entity's masterly swordsmanship and superb combat senses from its past life have been reconstructed through the Demon Realm's miasma.

Within its skeletal frame, the miasma is intensely condensed. By releasing it outward, it can shroud itself in a solid 'armor' that mitigates any physical impact or magical interference.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_203
DisplayDesc:
An entity cloaked in a pitch-black robe and a deeply pulled-down hood. While its veiled face is completely indiscernible, a pair of chilling eyes gleam from the darkness. 

Legless beneath its long coat, it floats serenely through the air, trailing black demonic energy and exuding a potent dark power that indiscriminately siphons the life energy of everything around it. 

Those struck by the massive scythe in its hand suffer not only the excruciating pain of torn flesh but also have their very life force drained away.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_204
DisplayDesc:
A human that has transformed into a grotesque zombie corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Unlike ordinary corpses, it is empowered by miasma, granting it superhuman physical capabilities and razor-sharp claws. It attacks the living to spread infection, relentlessly multiplying its kind.

Though formidable foes possessing tenacity and rapid mobility, it has completely lost reason, driven solely by an unslakable instinct for slaughter.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_205
DisplayDesc:
A human that has transformed into a grotesque zombie corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Unlike ordinary corpses, it is empowered by miasma, granting it superhuman physical capabilities and razor-sharp claws. It attacks the living to spread infection, relentlessly multiplying its kind.

Unlike ordinary zombies, it is characterized by the highly concentrated miasma condensed within its body, with demonic miasma crystallized across various parts of its body. Should one be attacked by it, the speed of infection and mutation is incomparably faster than that of ordinary zombies.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_206
DisplayDesc:
A human that has transformed into a grotesque zombie corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Unlike ordinary corpses, it is empowered by miasma, granting it superhuman physical capabilities and razor-sharp claws. It attacks the living to spread infection, relentlessly multiplying its kind.

Unlike ordinary zombies, it features an abnormally high physical density, with demonic miasma crystallized across various parts of its body. Its mind is entirely focused on a brutal bloodlust, driven solely to dismember any living being before it.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_207
DisplayDesc:
An entity manifested when a shadow spirit possesses the physical flesh of the deceased that had been corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Shrouded in dense miasma, it lurks in the darkness to ambush humans, devouring their life energy while inflicting excruciating pain.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_208
DisplayDesc:
An entity manifested when a shadow spirit possesses the physical flesh of the deceased that had been corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm.

Shrouded in dense miasma, it mesmerizes humans from the shadows, silently devouring their life energy.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_209
DisplayDesc:
Undead corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm and brought back to life by force, with nothing but bones remaining.

Forced back to life, it brandishes whatever broken or rusted weapons it used while living to take the lives of the mortal.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_210
DisplayDesc:
Undead corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm and brought back to life by force, with nothing but bones remaining.

Driven by the backlash of its resurrection, it instinctively unleashes the demonic miasma within itself to hunt down the living.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_211
DisplayDesc:
Undead corrupted by the miasma of the Demon Realm and brought back to life by force, with nothing but bones remaining.

Particles lingering within its skeletal structure react with the miasma, emitting an eerie aura of death.

While the miasma it emits is not immediately lethal enough to drain a living being's life force, prolonged exposure gradually paralyzes the senses and eventually degrades the victim into another undead entity.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_212
DisplayDesc:
Demon, Revenant Knight.
A high-ranking demon known as a 'Wraith', who possesses the ability to temporarily grant life to the deceased and control them.

She serves as one of the Revenant Knights under the Wraith Lord—the self-proclaimed Corpse Lord—and is called the Black Yaksha for her command over black miasma. She also commands a golem instantiated through her powers.

It is said that her black miasma corrodes the flesh of the living, turning them into living statues.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_226
DisplayDesc:
A UFS soldier. Originally served in an infantry division, but had lost all her comrades in a certain operation. She herself lost all her limbs, so she switched to a position as a cyborg soldier. She now doesn't belong to a specific unit, and acts alone as a single offensive unit. She distances herself from others on purpose, acting cold and unmoved. But she is kind-hearted at heart, so she helps others in secret.

Her main weapon is a plasma rifle. She self-generates by using the kinetic energy from her android arms and legs, supplying the electron ammo for the plasma rifle almost perpetually.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_235

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_236
DisplayDesc: Yatsu Murasaki [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_237
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, Mizuki Yukikaze's mother. She temporarily retired from dangerous missions after giving birth to Yukikaze to work as Igawa Asagi's advisor. However, she was forced to return to the field after her husband was killed in action.

Although she claims to be "out of shape compared to her best days", her skills are on a par with the 'Almighty' Igawa Asagi. She is known as the "Phantom Taimanin", and is dreaded by many in the dark side.

She plays an active role alongside Asagi in the overall management of Gosha. Externally, she is in charge of close negotiations with the Japanese government, while internally, she gives deep thought to the academy's curriculum and training programs, serving as a reliable backbone for Gosha.

User of Water Art, "Geneijin", an extremely rare skill even among Water Art users, allowing her to mold water skillfully into illusions. She can use the illusion as a decoy to mislead incoming attacks, or as a weapon to attack the enemies. Useful in both offense and defense.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_238
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. Although still a student, she is frequently on missions, and she is expected to be the leading force of the new generation. On missions, she often works with her senior Akiyama Rinko. She earned the nickname "Lightning Taimanin" for defeating her enemies with lightning bullets unleashed through ninja art.

She is almost perfect, except for her temper and pride, but very few know that she is in fact quite shy. She is mutually intimate with Akiyama Tatsuro, her childhood friend and Rinko's younger brother, but the two have little progress in romance. 

A user of the ninja art, "Lightning Art". It is said to be the most powerful among offensive ninja arts. In particular, Yukikaze is so overwhelmingly strong that she requires her twin-pistol limiters, the "Lightning Shooters", to keep it under control.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_239
DisplayDesc: Akiyama Rinko [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_240
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a teacher at Gosha Academy. Commonly known as "Shizuru of Flowers". A beautiful and talented female who's fluent in six different languages, has two doctorate degrees, and has expertise in multiple fields. She's a specialist in undercover operations with the ability to disguise herself as any individual.

She's also a skilled fighter who uses Wood Art. She doesn't carry a weapon but can create a whip made of rose vines with her ninja art when she fights.

At Gosha Academy, she works as an English teacher and commands the full attention of the male students. And she skillfully uses the situation to manage them with ease.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_241
DisplayDesc: Shinganji Kurenai [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_242
DisplayDesc: Fuuma Kotaro [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_243
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, the butler of the Fuuma clan and a teacher at Gosha Academy.

She is a daughter whom Fuuma Danjo had with his mistress, which makes her Fuuma Kotaro's half-sister. She is a talented Taimanin who calls Fuuma Kotaro "Master" and supports him in every way. When the Fuuma clan was in danger of collapsing after losing the battle against Taimanins led by the Igawa clan, she did her best to have Fuuma Kotaro succeed and continue to lead the clan, then became his guardian at only 11 years old.

Inheriting the characteristic of the Fuuma clan, she uses the ninja art of Evil Eye. Unlike other Evil Eye abilities, her "Clairvoyance" is activated by closing her eye, which lets her spy anywhere she wants without the need to physically move. She can secretly gather info from books or computers with her ninja art.

Also, she is known to be the best at using a kunai among the Fuuma clan, and can even hit hidden targets using her Evil Eye with pinpoint accuracy.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_244
DisplayDesc: Amamiya Shisui [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_245
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. An elite student who is a member of the student council. Born into a family that has served the Fuuma clan for generations, she always takes care of Fuuma. She claims to be 150cm tall, and she gets furious when someone claims she's actually only 149cm tall.

Out of the Beast Art users, she's a "Beast Transformer" who uses the power to transform into a beast. Her beast type is a "Devil fish", i.e, an octopus. According to her, "Hebiko" (meaning snake woman in Japanese) is her great-grandmother's name, who was able to transform into a serpent as a Beast Transformer.

When transformed, her legs become flexible octopus tentacles. They can grow up to 30m and regrow even if they are cut off. She specializes in the Four-Wielding style, in which she wields four daggers in her hands and tentacles. However, what people are really afraid of is her ink, which is notorious for its fishy smell that doesn't go away for at least three days.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_246
DisplayDesc: Onisaki Kirara [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_247
DisplayDesc: Kannazuki Sora [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_248
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. She works hard every day as a class representative. A little clumsy, but always puts a bright smile on her face.

Possesses unbelievably powerful physical strength, even among Taimanins. Despite her status as a student, she often goes out on missions. Despite her outstanding physical abilities, it's always her clumsiness that keeps her from being perfect.

User of the ninja art, Earth Art. She fights in a style applying Earth Art to her own fists. Furthermore, her exclusive weapon is a prototype scroll bullet, which enables her to use abilities other than Earth Art.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_249
DisplayDesc: Kamimura Maika [Gosha Academy]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_250
DisplayDesc: Mizuki Shiranui [Kimono]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_251
DisplayDesc: Mizuki Yukikaze [Kimono]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_252
DisplayDesc: Igawa Asagi [Kimono]

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_253
DisplayDesc:
The leader of all Taimanins, a group of ninjas who fight for justice. Serves as the headmistress of Gosha Academy, the educational institute for Taimanins.

Utilizes master swordsmanship and superhuman physical capabilities, in addition to her ninja art that allows her to move at a speed beyond human perception. She has awakened her true power during a certain mission. Her weapon of choice is a ninja katana.

User of the supernatural ninja art, Hawk Art. The art heightens her senses and physical capabilities for one second, allowing her to move as if six seconds have passed. She perceives the world in slow motion while using her ninja art; others perceive her as moving at the speed of light. Since her ninja art greatly exhausts her, she cannot use it multiple times at once.

Though she normally maintains her dignity as the Chief Commander of the Taimanins and the headmistress of the academy, she set aside those titles at the earnest request of a beloved junior—who, eyes sparkling, pleaded, "I want to see Miss Asagi at her most beautiful." This is her, clad in the wedding dress prepared by that junior.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_254
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a teacher at Gosha Academy. She is from a family of the lower ninja faction that serves Asagi as their master. Her brother, Yatsu Kuro, is also active as a Taimanin. She is expected to become the next Asagi, the captain of the new generation Taimanins.

It's hard to know from her cold appearance, but she is kind and thoughtful. She has strong feelings towards Asagi, which seem more than simple admiration, so she becomes much softer in front of her. She likes cats, but unfortunately, cats are afraid of her.

User of the supernatural ninja art, "Awakened Immortal", which allows her to become immortal with superhuman restoration abilities. Unless her heart and brain are destroyed simultaneously, she will remain immortal. Furthermore, her immortal body has unimaginable power and agility, which allows her to perform powerful hand-to-hand combat and to swing her giant axe without breaking a sweat.

Driven by her earnest desire to take a photo together with Asagi—whom she cherishes beyond mere admiration—while wearing a wedding dress, she finally realizes a long-held dream after making a heartfelt request. A demon realm doctor attempted to exploit that desire by setting a vile trap, but was met with ruthless retribution from Murasaki, who was enraged that their precious time together had been disrupted and that her disciple had been dragged into the ordeal.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_255
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. Though earnest and somewhat rigid, she has a cautious personality and rarely speaks up on her own.

She enjoys her school life with Shinohara Mari, Kasumigaoka Rika, Shimizu Kanna, and others, and is affectionately called "Mai-chan" by those around her. She has a unique way of addressing others—for example, she calls her classmate Shinohara Mari "Senior Mari-chan", while calling her actual senior Shimizu Kanna "Senior Kan-chan".

User of the ninja art, "Paper Spirit", which enhances paper by infusing it with Taimanin particles. It is a highly adaptive ninja art that is capable of dealing with various situations such as snaring enemies or transforming into blades or explosives.

While visiting the simulator for her usual self-training, she happens to witness Murasaki attempting to persuade Asagi. Out of consideration, she is allowed to enter the training room first, but ends up falling into a trap set by a Demon Realm doctor that was originally meant for Murasaki, leading to an incident where she is bound by an "Eternal Vow".

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_256
DisplayDesc:
A Taimanin who mainly participates in front-line combat. She often zones out, which is why she doesn't really stand out in combat training. But she is surprisingly persistent in actual combat.

She is usually seen alone most of the time, but it doesn't mean she dislikes others. Rather, she has a strong bond with her teammates and does not tolerate anyone who injures them. She is very frugal and is not interested in anything but spending time with wild birds she feeds.

Possesses the Eclipse Meld, which is a ninja art that absorbs powers from every exchange of blows during combat against an enemy. The longer the battle, the more powerful it becomes, but it takes some time to fully kick in.

One day, after much persuasion from her companions, Hisui ended up joining a vacation crew. However, the swimsuit she wore was surprisingly daring, in complete contrast to the image she normally projected. Since she knew nothing about fashion and didn't even have friends to consult, she simply bought the swimsuit recommended by the store clerk without thinking too much about it.

Despite drawing everyone's attention on the beach, Hisui—who couldn't care less about what others think—just sat on the sand with her usual vacant expression. Spending time alone amidst the bustle of her companions, she was, in her own unique way, fully enjoying the vacation.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_257
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a teacher at Gosha Academy. Commonly known as "Shizuru of Flowers". A beautiful and talented female who's fluent in six different languages, has two doctorate degrees, and has expertise in multiple fields. She's a specialist in undercover operations with the ability to disguise herself as any individual.

She's also a skilled fighter who uses Wood Art. She doesn't carry a weapon but can create a whip made of rose vines with her ninja art when she fights.

Her ability to seduce others with her bewitching charm is one of her talents, essential for undercover missions.

When this alluring woman changed into her swimsuit, her breathtaking beauty and overwhelming sensuality were more than enough to instantly command the attention of the entire beach.

Her figure in a swimsuit went far beyond being simply 'impossible to ignore'. Anyone who caught even a fleeting glimpse of her was so spellbound that, with each returning summer, the radiant image of that day would forever play in their minds like an unerasable afterimage.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_258
DisplayDesc:
Taimanin, a student of Gosha Academy. The successor of the Itto Style, a swordsmanship style that has been passed down in the ninja village for generations. Famous for her nickname "Savage Hunter", she is respected as a strong, elegant, and strict senior student in Gosha Academy. She is so popular among girls that a fan club of hers is secretly growing in size without her even knowing it exists.

A childhood friend of "Lightning Taimanin", Mizuki Yukikaze, as well as her sister figure. She is almost always seen with Yukikaze and supports her faithfully. Aside from her, her known connections are her younger brother Akiyama Tatsuro and her junior Fuuma Kotaro.

User of the supernatural ninja art, Void Art. On the basis that she can manipulate space, she can perceive things from a great distance by shifting her senses, or shift herself and others around her into a distant location. Void Art is highly versatile, but teleporting in rapid succession has the risk of exhausting her.

One day, unable to withstand the persistent coaxing of her companions, Rinko reluctantly ended up joining the beach vacation.

Though usually revered for her strict and impeccable demeanor, her appearance in a swimsuit unveiled a physique beautifully sculpted by years of rigorous training, radiating an undeniable sensuality that was impossible to hide.

Even amidst the avalanche of passionate glances she drew in her wake, she walked with absolute confidence. Her mere presence was so imposing that it was more than enough to dominate the entire beach in an instant.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_269
DisplayDesc:
A student Taimanin.

Widely regarded as the second most skilled fighter right behind Asagi, she is a highflier destined to lead the next generation of Taimanins.

Her cool exterior makes it hard to tell, but she's actually quite gentle at heart. Though she adores cats, it breaks her heart that they always seem terrified of her.

Her feelings for Asagi run so deep that she completely loses her cool and turns into a flustered mess whenever Asagi is around. Her dream since childhood has been to marry her. Ever since Asagi offhandedly agreed to Murasaki's condition—"If I can beat you in a spar, please take me as your bride"—Murasaki hasn't skipped a single day of training to make that promise come true.

She is a master of the ninja art "Awakened Immortal". True to its name, this art grants her an immortal body with superhuman regenerative abilities, allowing her to overcome death itself unless her heart and brain are destroyed simultaneously. Furthermore, she unleashes monstrous strength and explosiveness unimaginable from her slender frame, lightly swinging a colossal axe to dominate absolute close-quarters combat.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_271
DisplayDesc:
The heir of the prestigious Igawa clan's main house and a prominent kunoichi, spotlighted as a leader among Taimanins.

Armed with her genius-level swordsmanship and martial arts, she wields the ninja sword "Accursed Rokumon" as her primary weapon, a keepsake left behind by her father, Igawa Shuzen.

She is a master of the ninja art "Hawk Art", which enables light-speed movements that far transcend normal human perception.

Her specialty is "Ninja Art: Satsujinka", a technique often described as a form of cloning.

"Ninja Art: Satsujinka" allows her to control up to hundreds of clones to assault her enemies. 
As long as the target is within her line of sight, she can instantaneously deploy these clones anywhere, like a fighter jet locking onto its target.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_272
DisplayDesc:
A Taimainin who supported Gosha during its dawning days as Igawa Asagi's right hand, making a name for herself with both martial prowess and strategy under the alias "Phantom Shiranui".

She is also the mother of a child. While she exudes a gentle and calm aura, she is a woman of quiet passion who possesses a steadfast character that absolutely refuses to tolerate injustice.

Among Water Artists, she is a highly rare user of "Genejin", an art that skillfully manipulates water to create illusions. By using illusions as a shield to evade attacks or double-teaming enemies alongside her phantoms, she boasts overwhelming efficiency in both offense and defense.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_300
DisplayDesc:
The true form of Snake Lady, the host of the Chaos Arena. Her identity is that of a snake goddess and one of the three chieftains of the Naga race, revered in India under the name "Kaliya".

A highly dangerous mythical demon, she possesses a sadistic streak, taking pleasure in injecting victims with deadly venom through mere touch just to watch them suffer.

She has clashed with numerous Taimanins—including their commander-in-chief, Igawa Asagi—and while records of her combat style are logged within the Gosha database, it is widely suspected that she has yet to display her true power.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_301
DisplayDesc:
Demon. Chieftess of a high-ranking Oni clan known as the "Frost Phantoms". The name "Ragnarok" is passed down from the legendary king who unified the Frost Phantoms in the past. Her real name is "Shinmora". She fell in love with a Taimanin from the human world and gave birth to Freya, whom she still watches over.

She's the strongest swordsman among the Frost Phantoms, using the demonic frost blade "Laevatein". She displays formidable power, combining the Frost Phantom's unique frost magic and swordsmanship.  Additionally, she founded a demon mafia called "Banshee" consisting of Frost Phantoms, where she serves as their boss.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_302
DisplayDesc:
Demon. The Queen of Vampires who rose to the throne and holds the esteemed title of "Crimson Lord", one of the 9 nobles who rule over the Demon Realm. Uncharacteristically friendly toward humans for a vampire, she upholds the belief in "dignified and controlled vampirism", seeking mutual respect and coexistence between vampires and humans.

Renowned for her overwhelming power even among vampires, she bears the title "Blood Lord", one who commands blood itself. She is a master of blood magic, capable of effortlessly defeating even the mightiest foes. Her close aide is the Hell Knight Marika Krishna, who serves as her personal bodyguard.

For those in the underworld who believe in superstitions and rely on spells rather than modern medicine, even an orc can be a lifesaver.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_145
DisplayDesc: A wizard who made a contract with an interdimensional being, allowing it to use supernatural powers. It uses all means necessary to fulfill its lust for knowledge, and cases of it destroying an entire village just to test a new destruction spell are common.

It operates in auto-combat mode, attacking any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_186

A bipedal combat drone developed using covertly acquired Demon Realm technology alongside UFS's cutting-edge science.

It automatically patrols designated zones and acts as a ruthless killing machine, immediately eliminating any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_188
DisplayDesc:

It remains airborne over designated zones to monitor vast areas. Upon locking onto any target not identified as friendly by its IFF system, this killing machine ruthlessly eliminates them under a relentless barrage of quad-linked missiles.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_171
DisplayDesc: A giant worm-like demon beast that lives underground in the Demon Realm. It sometimes comes over to the human world, disturbing the ecosystem. It has a habit of spitting acidic poison to weaken its prey when hunting. The said poison is sometimes used as a natural cutting fluid in the Demon Realm.

Name: Tbl_Unit_Name_172
DisplayDesc: A giant worm-like demon beast that lives underground in the Demon Realm. It sometimes comes over to the human world, disturbing the ecosystem. Mostly found in the volcanic regions, this subspecies has lost its poison but gained the ability to spit overheated bodily fluids.
